Chat and completion endpoints support streaming responses.

Chat Completions API

The stream field sends partial results using Server-sent events.

Embeddings API

Embedding tasks map input strings into embedding vectors.

Field Type Description
completion_tokens Integer Number of generated tokens.
prompt_tokens Integer Number of input tokens.
total_tokens Integer Number of total tokens.
reasoning_tokens Integer Number of thinking tokens.
